query: What are the symptoms and remedies for error code SPN-CR-001?
ground_truth_answer: SPN-CR-001 indicates a spindle bearing temperature rise. Diagnostic steps: 1) Check coolant flow to bearing assembly, 2) Verify spindle RPM is within nominal range, 3) Inspect bearing for excess friction. Remedy: Reduce spindle speed by 10-15% and allow 30 min cool-down before resuming operations.

query: How do I interpret error code severity levels?
ground_truth_answer: Error codes are classified into 8 severity levels: CRITICAL (machine stop required), MAJOR (operation limited), SERIOUS (prompt intervention), MODERATE (plan intervention), MINOR (log and monitor), WARNING (informational), NOTICE (advisory), ADVISORY (background). Each error code document specifies its severity and recommended actions.

query: What is the p-value threshold for detecting spindle bearing fault anomalies?
ground_truth_answer: Based on the Bosch dataset observations, vibration anomalies in spindle bearings are considered significant at p-value < 0.05. Historical data shows 20 confirmed spindle bearing faults with p-values ranging 0.001-0.045, indicating high statistical significance in the fault signal.

query: Describe the diagnostic procedure for error code CNC-MD-011.
ground_truth_answer: CNC-MD-011 indicates tool offset memory data corruption. Diagnostic procedure: (1) Power cycle the CNC control unit, (2) Run memory self-test from diagnostics menu, (3) If test fails, reload tool offset table from backup, (4) Verify tool height compensation with G-code dry run, (5) Resume normal operations after offset validation.

query: Can you help me with a warranty claim for a spindle bearing replacement on machine M02?
ground_truth_answer: For spindle bearing warranty claims, please provide: (1) machine serial number (M02 in this case), (2) date of failure, (3) operating hours at time of failure, (4) any error codes displayed. Warranty coverage requires proof of proper maintenance logs. Processing typically takes 5-7 business days after documentation review.

query: What should I do if the machine displays a chatter vibration warning but continues operating?
ground_truth_answer: Chatter vibration warnings indicate potential tool breakage or workpiece slipping. Recommended actions: (1) STOP the spindle immediately, (2) Inspect tool flutes for damage, (3) Check workpiece clamp pressure, (4) Measure part dimensions to detect chatter marks, (5) Contact support if you cannot identify the root cause. Do not resume until issue is resolved.
